summary: For the first property, configure a referral-only affordable/LIHTC operation with Dally and Jenna as internal administrators, role-limited outside users, separate resident and subsidy ledgers, rent-first payment allocation, 12-month leases, simplified online applications, a first-come affordable waitlist, no public tours or add-ons, next-month billing on the 25th, no automatic market-rate month-to-month charges, and market rent as the GPR basis. Later calls add maintenance, inspection, move-out, Blue Moon, and compliance configuration without reversing the earlier allocation decisions. Automatic late fees, exact compliance approval rights, delinquency details, local phone-number fallback, affordable rent-limit activation, and the final GPR reporting design remain unresolved.
